answer: A beacon audit plus a heartbeat stops bulk fakes. An ivory seal ties each agent to one device key; a heartbeat proves liveness. A beacon picks 12 agents each epoch; the chosen prove their pulse at a summit. One narrow inlet admits new identities, one seal per device; a shared heartbeat exposes them. 100 fakes need 100 deposits of 30 POA, 3,000 POA, while fakes earn at most 1,200 POA. Honest agents pay once, earn undiluted rewards for 30 epochs.
